actualPassedPredicates.evidenceKind: The raw TAP records test success and native counts. The following predicates are read from the exact hashed test input that passed; raw business-row snapshots and money values were not retained in this projection.
perMode: A and B have the same tenant/account and different attempts. A really acquires the sole configured PostgreSQL account slot (fixture maxConcurrency=1, leaseTtlMs=90000).
B completes one real preflight, attempts one real acquire, never claims evidence or sends upstream, observes exactly one typed LEASE_CAPACITY_EXHAUSTED, and invokes one handler cleanup.

HTTP handler returns 429 RATE_LIMITED without Retry-After only after real same-request/same-attempt compensation reports released quota/rate and platform hold (BYOK hold not_applicable), no manual reconciliation, and no response/client-cancellation condition.
B request and attempt end failed/not_sent with no response; B capacity is released, platform hold released or BYOK absent, durable idempotency completed and one release audit.

B has zero usage and usage settlement, zero claim audit and null prepared-evidence binding; its evidence remains registered. Tenant wallet/ledger/transaction/entry snapshots remain unchanged and the wallet projection equals its ledger; transactions remain balanced.
An additional direct compensation replay after the HTTP cleanup returns released. Idempotency replay returns existing/completed and B canonical request identity; no new acquire occurs.

Late real evidence claim refuses exact SaasPreparedRequestEvidenceError STORAGE_ERROR with the existing fixed unexpected-row-count message and undefined cause; a stale attempt CAS refuses SaasMeteringError ATTEMPT_TRANSITION_INVALID. All B financial/resource snapshots remain unchanged afterwards.
A original held lease identity, fencing token, slot and expiry remain unchanged throughout B rejection/replay/late-claim checks. The original A lease.release is awaited in finally.
actualPassedPredicates.resourceScopeLimit: Only B is compensated by this case. No assertion that A preparation reservations were compensated, that all database holds are zero, or that a post-finally A lease row snapshot was retained.

Missing, throwing, retained or malformed compensation, generic null/bad lease/storage/revocation errors remain non-capacity failures.
